_comment: Evolution on SimScale. Fill the four FILL_ME values (see SIMSCALE.md), then cron `python campaign.py tick <dir>`. Budgets are cars per method run; lower them to fit your SimScale quota. SimScale's drag is only compared with SimScale's own reference car (made once per stage); the winners are re-timed in our OpenFOAM pipeline on GitHub Actions.

evaluator.max_cost: FILL_ME (SimScale's per-run estimate, e.g. core hours)

_rules: Design rules (CarSpec switches): no virtual cargo; nothing in the sidepod region above 27.175 mm (the team STEP's sidepod top; also used for the T4.4.2 halo cap, which the STEP itself reaches); milled from top and bottom only (3.175 mm ball); 3 mm minimum walls; no loose pieces; sidepod region only.
